en: The image shows a historical street scene with people dressed in late 19th or early 20th-century clothing. There are old buildings lining the street, one of which has a sign reading 'HOTELL' and another sign mentioning 'KONDITORI'. The street name 'Norra Larmgatan' and the city name 'Göteborg' are clearly visible. The image has a hand-tinted or colorized look typical of early postcards.
